revision_summary: Two fixes needed. (1) Minor quote fix: script_coverage co_owner entry attributes the full line 'Anybody... Some stuff on the title?' to a single ts/speaker turn at 01:11, but the transcript shows this is split across two turns and two speakers \u2014 rep says 'Anybody' at 01:09-01:11 boundary and customer replies 'Some stuff on the title?' at 01:11, then clarifies 'Nobody else on the title' at 01:14. Fix the quote to either cite the rep's actual question fragment at the correct ts or restructure to show the split exchange accurately. (2) Schema misreference: two cherry_pick_moments entries (ground-mount DQ items) cite 'dq_rules' and 'dq_rules.roof_too_old_no_replacement' as if the ground-mount capability limitation is an enumerated hard DQ in the schema. It is not \u2014 the dq_rules section only lists not_homeowner, ppa_existing_system, sunrun_existing, pink_solar_existing, roof_too_old_no_replacement, credit_below_670_no_alternative, and existing_system_broken. Ground-mount-only property is a real operational dead-end but is NOT currently schema-defined. Stage 3 should flag this explicitly as a gap ('this DQ condition has no matching dq_rules entry \u2014 recommend Kenny add ground_mount_only_no_roof_option as a new hard DQ') rather than citing an existing rule (roof_too_old_no_replacement) that describes an unrelated condition (roof age/replacement timing, not mount type). This is a precision issue that could mislead a manager into thinking the schema already covers this scenario.
